# Front differential internal rebuild procedure

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Place the front diff on a work bench with rags underneath and remove the front cover. [t2125]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Place the front diff on a work bench with rags underneath and remove the front cover.
2. Remove four 14mm nuts from the passenger side flange, mark the position, then slide out the long axle shaft.
3. On the driver's side, remove one central 14mm bolt where the CV shaft mounts to access the axle shaft.
4. Slide out the driver's side axle shaft after removing its center bolt.
5. Remove two bearing journals using 17mm bolts per side.
6. Pull out the ring and carrier assembly from inside the diff, prying if necessary.
7. [Partial] Note which sides have bearing races and large washer/spacers to ensure correct reassembly order.
8. Remove all bolts holding the stock ring gear onto the carrier and remove the ring gear itself.
9. Punch out the roll pin holding the cross shaft in place; do not fully remove it, just enough for movement.
10. Slide the cross shaft out of the carrier assembly.
11. Remove two small spider gears and their rounded washers from behind them.
12. Remove axle gears and thrust washers located behind the gears, ensuring left and right sides are distinguished.
13. Install new Lokka axle gears with thrust washers into the carrier.
14. Insert Lokka spacers into the center of the gear stacks with flat ends facing toward the carrier center.
15. Slide the cross shaft back in and measure clearance between it and the spacer (target: 0.006-0.020 inches).
16. Ensure no more than a 0.010 inch difference exists between left and right side clearances.
17. Install cam gears if present, measuring inter-cam spacing for a gap of 0.145-0.165 inches.
18. [Partial] Punch out the stock driver's side flange lock nut that was pressed into the axle gear to make room for parts.
19. Machine down the punched-out lock nut just enough so cam gears can slide in without hitting it.
20. Install pins and springs, then re-insert the cross shaft and punch the roll pin back into place.
21. [Partial] Reinstall the ring gear to its original spot and torque bolts to spec.
22. Place assembly back into the diff housing with bearing races and spacers on correct sides.
23. Install bearing journals and torque them to specification.
24. [Partial] Slide axle shafts back in and torque flange nuts to spec.
25. [Partial] [Unverified value] Reattach the differential cover with a new gasket or sealant, then fill with about 2 liters of fluid.

_Procedure reported by [t2125]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-lokk-and-drop-your-front-diff-front-lokka-and-diff-drop-bushings-install.4679/>_
